name: dwcode
description: DWCode monorepo — Next.js client + layered application backend.
//workspaces: npm workspaces (REF-01). @dwcode/shared holds the difficulty registry and
scoring rules that client/ and server/ previously duplicated.
DEPLOYMENT: this changes how both platforms must install. See

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev:client" "npm:dev:server"
scripts.//build: shared MUST build first — both packages consume its dist/.
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w dwcode-client && npm run lint -w dwcode-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w dwcode-client && npm run typecheck -w dwcode-server
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w dwcode-client && npm run test -w dwcode-server
